validation_policy: Do not inspect validation100 outputs or reviews for prompt design; freeze prompt after development/regression before running validation. Final holdout result used once, not iteratively optimized.
stop_policy: Stop after clear semantic regression or two consecutive rounds without supported development improvement. Ambiguous sources isolated, not assigned guessed targets.

additional_experiment: One explicitly separate second-pass draft-cleaning control after three single-pass prompt candidates. Do not confuse its quality/cost with single-pass generation.
additional_fewshot_ablation: Test three concise contrastive examples on unchanged baseline prompt to distinguish verbal correction from actual history; no further rules added. Fixed screening only; validation still sealed.
